types.name: Automaton
docs: A memory design read as a matrix ladder: the rule, the transfer matrix on its `(k-1)`-window states, and the peel depth its Dirichlet series is continued from.
The elements are the positive integers whose minimal base-`q` string, `q = 2^D`, is accepted by the rule, and the object is `zeta_W(s) = sum n^(-s)` over them.

`crate::memory::Rule::accepts` holds a word shorter than the width `k` to be accepted, there being no window in it, so every integer below `q^(k-1)` with a nonzero leading digit sits in `S_W` for every rule of that width, and the head polynomial carries them.

With `E_j(w)` the vector whose entry `u` sums `n^(-w)` over accepted words of exactly `j` digits ending in state `u`, and `G_P = sum_(j >= P) E_j`, splitting a word on its last digit gives `(I - q^(-w) T) G_P(w) = E_P(w) + sum_(l >= 1) binom(-w, l) q^(-w-l) Gamma_l G_P(w+l)`, where `Gamma_l(u', u) = sum a^l` over the letters `a` with the window `(u, a)` allowed and `u' = shift(u, a)`, and `T = Gamma_0` is `crate::memory::transfer` transposed.

Then `zeta_W(w) = 1^T D_(P-1)(w) + 1^T G_P(w)` with `D_(P-1)` the Dirichlet polynomial over the accepted words of at most `P-1` digits, and the scalar ladder of `crate::ladder` is the width one case with `card F` where `T` stands.

types.name: Layout
docs: A force-directed layout: every node repels every other, every branch pulls its ends together, and a cooling cap on the move per tick lets the lattice settle.

starting box. The temperature caps the move of any node in one tick and cools linearly from
a tenth of the extent to a floor over the first ticks, then holds, so the layout keeps
creeping toward rest. The seed jitters the start so a symmetric lattice can fold.

types.name: Design
docs: A digit design: the base `q`, the digit set `F` its elements are written with, and the peel depth `P` its ladder starts at.

The elements are the whole numbers whose base-`q` digits all lie in `F` with a nonzero leading digit, and the object is their Dirichlet series `zeta_F(s) = sum n^(-s)`, of abscissa `alpha = log_q k` for `k = card F`.

With `E_j` the sum over the elements of exactly `j` digits and `G_P = sum_(j >= P) E_j`, splitting an element on its last digit gives `(1 - k q^(-w)) G_P(w) = E_P(w) + sum_(l >= 1) binom(-w, l) q^(-w-l) gamma_l G_P(w+l)` with `gamma_l = sum_(a in F) a^l`, and `zeta_F = D_(P-1) + G_P` for the finite Dirichlet polynomial `D_(P-1)` over the elements below `q^(P-1)`.
The `l`-series has ratio `max F / q^P`, so the peel depth buys the convergence and the small quantity `G_P` is carried directly, never as a difference of two large ones.

types.name: Rule
docs: A rule on `k` consecutive digits of a design word.
The alphabet is the `2^D` digit vectors `d` of `{0, 1}^D`, each read as the corner integer `c = sum_i d[i] 2^i`, with `x` bit `0`, `y` bit `1` and `z` bit `2`.
A window is `k` digits `(c_1, ..., c_k)` read as `w = sum_j c_j 2^(D (k - j))`, the first digit most significant, and the code has bit `w` set exactly when that window is allowed.
The code therefore lives in `[0, 2^(2^(k D)))`, which forces `k D <= SPAN`.
A word `d_1 d_2 ... d_L` is read coarsest digit first and is accepted when every window of `k` consecutive digits is allowed; for `L < k` there is no window, so every word is accepted.
Width 1 is the memoryless design of the same code: the cells of `bang dim <dim>, code <code>` at that level.

types.name: Carry
docs: The carry automaton of the Kummer set `K_(a,b) = {k : p does not divide C(a k, b k)}` at a prime `p`.

By Kummer's theorem `v_p(C(a k, b k))` counts the carries of the addition `b k + (a - b) k` in base `p`, so `k` lies in the set exactly when that addition carries nowhere. The digits of `k` are read from the units, and the state is the pair `(c_1, c_2)` of carries of the multiplications by `b` and by `a - b`, `c_1 < b` and `c_2 < a - b`. In state `(c_1, c_2)` the digit `d` meets the digits `x = (b d + c_1) mod p` of `b k` and `y = ((a - b) d + c_2) mod p` of `(a - b) k`; it is allowed when `x + y <= p - 1` and moves to `(floor((b d + c_1)/p), floor(((a - b) d + c_2)/p))`. Past the top digit the zeros spend the carries, and `k` lies in the set when every digit and every one of those zeros is allowed.

fields.name: moves

fields.name: num

fields.name: den
docs: The denominator of `gamma` in lowest terms, a divisor of `b^2 - 1`.

fields.name: eta

fields.name: amplitude_im

types.name: Battery
docs: The battery's verdict on one stream, every correlation over the same `N`.

fields.name: count
docs: The `N` every statistic runs over: the pairs `n < N`, so `z = abs(r) sqrt(N)` is the caller's.

fields.name: mean
docs: The mean of `y(n)` over `n < N`.

fields.name: shift
docs: The shift test: the Pearson correlation of `y(n)` with `y(n + h)` for `h = 1..=64`, in that order.

fields.name: dilation
docs: The dilation test: the 44 pairs `(B, r)`, `2 <= B <= 9`, `r < B`, in that order.

fields.name: kernel
docs: The kernel test: the correlation of `y(b n)` with `y(b^2 n)` for `b = 2, 3`.

fields.name: square
docs: The dilation square: the mean of `y(n) y(2n) y(3n) y(6n)`.

types.name: Design
docs: A digit-parity design `b:D`, or Rudin-Shapiro: the sign `x(n)` is `-1` to the count of base-`b` digits of `n` in `D`.

fields.name: base
docs: The base, 2 through 6; a base outside that span is clamped into it.

fields.name: mask
docs: The digit set `D` as a bitmask, bit `d - 1` set when the digit `d` is in `D`; bits past the base's digits are ignored, and an empty set reads a constant sign.

fields.name: rudin
docs: Whether the design is Rudin-Shapiro, the parity of the `11` blocks in the binary digits, which ignores the base and the mask.

types.name: Dilation
docs: One dilation pair of the battery: `y(n)` against `y(scale n + offset)`.

fields.name: scale
docs: The factor `B`, 2 through 9.

fields.name: offset
docs: The remainder `r`, below the factor.

fields.name: correlation
docs: The Pearson correlation of the pair over the battery's `N` values of `n`.

types.name: Head
docs: A battery pair that is a near-head of a reading at the design's base: `P(psi(n)) = b^level (P(phi(n)) + shift) + tail`.

fields.name: kernel
docs: Whether the pair is a kernel pair `(b n, b^2 n)` rather than a dilation pair `(n, B n + r)`.

fields.name: scale
docs: The dilation's factor `B`, or the kernel's base `b`.

fields.name: offset
docs: The dilation's remainder `r`, zero for a kernel pair.

fields.name: level
docs: The level `L`, the count of digits the pair appends.

fields.name: shift
docs: The carry `q`, saturated into the field.

fields.name: tail
docs: The tail `s`, the digits appended below the carry.

fields.name: sign
docs: The design's sign at the tail, `x(s)`.

fields.name: exact
docs: Whether the pair reads `x(s)` at every `n`, so its correlation is exactly plus or minus one: `q = 0`, and for Rudin-Shapiro a tail whose top digit is zero.

types.name: Reading
docs: The sequences a design is read along: `y(n) = x(P(n))` for a polynomial `P`, or `x(p_n)` along the primes.

variants.name: N
docs: The design itself, `P(n) = n`.

variants.name: Square

docs: The pronic numbers, `P(n) = n^2 + n`.

variants.name: Cube

variants.name: Primes

types.name: Row
docs: One base-2 design read along the row word of odd sides `3, 5, ..., 2L+1`, out of its fill polynomial `P_F(n) = sum_j a_j n^(dim-j) (n-1)^j`.

The fill ratio is `(w/2^dim)^L L^drift C (1 + c_1/L + O(L^-2))`, `w` the corners, `drift = dim/2 - mean` and `c_1 = dim/8 + drift - var/2` over the odd count of the corners, and `C = Gamma(3/2)^dim / prod_i Gamma(2 - r_i)` over the roots of `P_F`.

fields.name: profile
docs: The odd-count profile: `a_j` corners with `j` odd coordinates, `j` from 0 to `dim`.

fields.name: drift
docs: The drift, the power of `L` the fill carries past its ratio per level, as a reduced fraction.

fields.name: correction
docs: The first correction `c_1`, as a reduced fraction.

fields.name: roots
docs: The roots of the fill polynomial: the zeros, the ones, the rational roots, then the rest.

fields.name: constant
docs: The constant `C`, the Gamma form at the roots.

fields.name: closed
docs: The constant spelled: a rational, a power of `sqrt(pi)`, and the Gamma, `cosh`, `cos` or `sin` values the roots leave.

fields.name: reflection
docs: The constant by reflection alone, `(sqrt(pi)/2)^(m_0 + m_1) prod_pairs sin(pi r)/(4 r (1-r))`, when every root outside `0, 1/2, 1` pairs with `1 - r`.

fields.name: mirror
docs: The constant times the mirror design's, `prod_i sin(pi r_i)/(4 r_i (1 - r_i))` with `pi/4` at a root 0 or 1.

fields.name: parity
docs: For a parity design at `dim >= 2`: whether its corners hold an odd count of odd coordinates, and its Wallis sieve product.

render follow on the same stream, so one seed always paints the same background.

docs: Returns every flat size in the range that passes the parity filter.

functions.name: nestings
docs: Returns every factor list of depth two and beyond whose product lands in the size range.

functions.name: powers
docs: Returns every factor and level whose power lands in the size range.

functions.name: products
docs: Returns every count-long factor list whose product lands in the size range.

functions.name: size
docs: Returns the side a factor raised to a level makes, or None when no usize holds it.
assert_eq!(mrly_tile::recipe::size(3, 3), Some(27));
assert_eq!(mrly_tile::recipe::size(3, 4294967298), None);

functions.name: uniform
docs: Returns whether every item equals the first, vacuously true for an empty or single list.
assert!(mrly_tile::recipe::uniform(&[3, 3, 3]));
assert!(!mrly_tile::recipe::uniform(&[3, 5, 3]));

functions.name: tree_mask
docs: Builds the mask of a mosaic tile: the two trees of the side, two where they cross.
assert_eq!(mrly_tile::build::tree_mask(3)?.sum(), 12);
# Ok::<(), mrly_core::Error>(())
# Errors
Errs when the side will not draw a tree.

functions.name: default
docs: Returns the default Config.

functions.name: new
docs: Builds a file of the given repetition counts with no image.

functions.name: is_cover
docs: Returns whether the edition paints the whole tiled canvas.

functions.name: is_prime
docs: Returns whether the edition paints the base cell before tiling.

functions.name: create
docs: Draws a variation's seed from the stream, then the variation itself on that seed, with a
mask when the edition is Neighbors.
use mrly_core::rng::Rng;
use mrly_tile::variation::{create, Config};
let mut rng = Rng::new(1);
assert_eq!(create(&Config::default(), &mut rng)?.key.len(), 8);
# Ok::<(), mrly_core::Error>(())
# Errors
Errs when the tile config draws no tile, or when the Neighbors mask will not draw.

functions.name: generate
docs: Builds the variation's base cell and draws its paint from the stream, painting the base
under a prime edition.
# Errors
Errs when the tile or its mask will not build, or when the paint will not lay down.

functions.name: render
docs: Renders every file of the variation to an image at the given scale, scattering a Random edition
from the stream.
# Errors
Errs when generate has not run, when a file will not tile, or on a scale below one.
